pipeline.modality: Oral live biotherapeutic product (consortium of bacteria)
pipeline.target: Gut microbiome reconstruction; epithelial barrier and immune homeostasis to reduce bacterial translocation

indications.indication: Reduction of bacterial bloodstream infections (BSIs) in adults undergoing allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplant (allo-HSCT)
indications.trial_design: Placebo-controlled Phase 2; final protocol submitted to FDA
indications.trial_status: PLANNED — Phase 1b completed (77% relative risk reduction in bacterial BSIs vs placebo); Phase 2 study start-up activities advanced; final protocol submitted to FDA. Breakthrough Therapy and Fast Track designations.
key_milestones: Phase 2 final protocol submitted to FDA

commercial_product.asset: VOWST (fecal microbiota spores, live-brpk; formerly SER-109)
commercial_product.indication: Prevention of recurrent C. difficile infection
commercial_product.status: FDA-approved Apr 2023; full rights transferred to Nestle Health Science Sept 30, 2024 (no longer Seres clinical asset)

excluded_preclinical.indication: Bacterial BSI/SBP prevention in chronic liver disease

excluded_legacy_terminated.reason: UC program; superseded by SER-603 preclinical work

excluded_partner_owned.reason: Transferred to Nestle Health Science Sept 2024
